The listening tests performed with our virtual room acoustic simulator show that the auralization method is a valid tool to be used for the evaluation of room acoustics.
• The auralization system is able to reproduce the acoustic characteristics of the virtual room, in a way that can be perceived by a listener.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of auralization tools, and with the study of the perception of the acoustic characteristics of rooms.
the study of sound perception in the context of the listening room.

auralization, a method for recreatng the aural impression (or the “auralization”) of a room, which is implemented through convolution, employing dry music (music recorded in an anechoic room) as source signal and passing it through a very long FIR (Finite Impulse Response) filter loaded with the coefficients of the impulse response of a room.

we have been able to show that the use of the beam tracing method to simulate room acoustics, and its implementation in real time in a listening room, can be very useful in the design of the room itself.

The main takeaway from our work is that
auralization can be used for subjective tests, and the results can be compared to those obtained by the use of a real room.

, when the room is simulated by means of the convolution of the dry source signal with the measured impulse response of the real room, the reproduction system has a strong influence on the perceived sound quality.
